definitions.explanation: An income tax deduction for taxpayers who financially support qualifying dependent family members (such as children over a certain age, parents, or other relatives with low income). Reduces the amount of income subject to tax.

examples.japanese: {扶養|ふよう}{控除|こうじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{十六歳|じゅうろくさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{扶養|ふよう}{控除|こうじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: When a child turns sixteen, they become eligible for the dependent deduction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高齢|こうれい}→高齢：14648_kourei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{扶養|ふよう}→扶養：21549_fuyou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、{扶養|ふよう}{控除|こうじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{受|う}けられる→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: If you are supporting an elderly parent, you can receive the dependent deduction.

examples.japanese: {扶養|ふよう}{控除|こうじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{扶養|ふよう}→扶養：21549_fuyou⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: The amount of the dependent deduction varies depending on the age of the dependent.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{扶養|ふよう}→扶養：21549_fuyou⟧ (support, maintenance of dependents) + ⟦{控除|こうじょ}→控除：07501_koujo⟧ (deduction). A standard category of {所得控除|しょとくこうじょ} (income deduction) in Japanese income tax. The deduction amount depends on the dependent's age and circumstances — for example, a higher deduction applies to dependents aged 19–22 (the typical university-age range) and to elderly dependents living with the taxpayer.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {扶養|ふよう}{控除|こうじょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to receive the dependent deduction
- {扶養|ふよう}{控除|こうじょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧: eligible for the dependent deduction
- {扶養|ふよう}{控除|こうじょ}{等|とう}{申告書|しんこくしょ}: dependent-deduction declaration form (submitted to employers)
- ⟦{特定|とくてい}→特定：04275_tokutei⟧⟦{扶養|ふよう}→扶養：21549_fuyou⟧⟦{親族|しんぞく}→親族：14199_shinzoku⟧: "specified dependent relative" — a higher-deduction category for certain ages

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{扶養|ふよう}→扶養：21549_fuyou⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧: dependent family member
- {所得控除|しょとくこうじょ}: income deduction — the broader tax category
- ⟦{配偶者|はいぐうしゃ}→配偶者：07430_haiguusha⟧⟦{控除|こうじょ}→控除：07501_koujo⟧: spouse deduction — a separate but related deduction for dependent spouses
- ⟦{医療費|いりょうひ}{控除|こうじょ}→医療費控除：23316_iryouhikoujo⟧: medical expense deduction

CULTURAL NOTE:
Dependents are generally required to have an annual income below a certain threshold (⟦{扶養|ふよう}→扶養：21549_fuyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{範囲|はんい}→範囲：03567_hani⟧) for the supporting family member to claim the deduction. This threshold influences how many hours part-time workers choose to work in order to remain within their family member's deduction eligibility.
